headword: {国外退去|こくがいたいきょ}

definitions.explanation: Being made to leave the country by the authorities, usually as a foreign national who has broken immigration law or committed a crime. Also used of a diplomat a government expels.

examples.japanese: {国外退去|こくがいたいきょ}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{命|めい}じる→命じる：02309_meijiru⟧。
examples.english: To order someone to leave the country.

examples.japanese: ⟦{彼|かれ}→彼：01292_kare⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{国外退去|こくがいたいきょ}⟦{処分|しょぶん}→処分：05520_shobun⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{受|う}けた→受ける：01215_ukeru⟧。
examples.english: He was served with a deportation order.

examples.japanese: ⟦ビザ→ビザ：08283_biza⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{切|き}れた→切れる：01936_kireru⟧まま⟦{働|はたら}いていた→働く：00503_hataraku⟧⟦{男性|だんせい}→男性：01655_dansei⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧、{国外退去|こくがいたいきょ}になった。
examples.english: A man who had been working on an expired visa was deported.

notes:
A legal and news term.
